explainer.title: What number rotation does
explainer.subtitle: Local presence dialing that protects your numbers' reputation.
explainer.localPresence: When you have several of your own numbers, Ringee automatically presents the one most likely to get answered — preferring a number with the same area code as the person you're calling (local presence). Local numbers get answered far more often than unfamiliar ones.
explainer.reputation: Calls are spread across your numbers with daily limits, and each number's health is tracked from its answer rate and very-short calls. A number that starts to look like spam is rested automatically until it recovers, so no single number gets burned.
explainer.compliance: Only numbers you own are ever used. This is local presence, never a fake or borrowed caller ID.
